2115714054320722315.en_summary: BIG OIL 3Q EARNINGS: Shell boosts share buybacks to ~$5 billion per quarter (from a rate of ~$3 billion previously) after delivering its 2nd highest ever quarterly net income thanks to high oil and LNG prices and -- most importantly -- record refining margins. $SHEL
2115714054320722315.zh_summary: 大型石油公司第三季財報：殼牌將股份回購提高至每季約50億美元（先前約30億美元），因高油價和液化天然氣價格以及——最重要的是——創紀錄的煉油利潤率，交付了有史以來第二高的季度淨收入。$SHEL

ticker_notes.SHEL: Boosted buybacks to $5B/qtr on record refining margins and high prices

2115713978663866744.en_summary: BIG OIL 3Q EARNINGS: French oil major TotalEnergies also posts very strong quarterly earnings on the back of high commodity prices and, even more important, eye-watering refining margins (its downstream business segment delivered record earnings). $TTE
